PERSONAL BY NATURE

Your baseline.
Never the average.

Thoughtful science. Clear insights. A little more understanding.

Compared with you

Every metric is measured against your own 60-day history. Because your normal is yours alone.

YOU ARE THE REFERENCE POINT

Research-informed

7-day rolling HRV averages, a normal zone that ignores day-to-day noise, and HRV from deep sleep, based on published readiness research.

Fully transparent

Every formula and weight is shown in the app. No black box. Just a clear view of what goes into your score.

Deep sleep insights

Sleep-stage timeline, efficiency, consistency, sleep debt, and overnight blood oxygen, heart rate, and temperature.

Workouts on your timeline

See exactly how much charge each workout cost. Connect the things you do with the way you feel.

Private by design

All data stays on your iPhone. No servers, no accounts, no tracking. Your health is your business.

ON YOUR PHONE. IN YOUR CONTROL.

A FEW MORE THINGS

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Explore the project on GitHub ↗
Is it on the App Store?+

Not yet. You can build it from source with Xcode; instructions are on GitHub.

What do I need?+

An iPhone with iOS 27 or later, plus a Mac with Xcode to build and install the app from source. An Apple Watch is strongly recommended.

Does it send my data anywhere?+

No. Everything is processed on your device and Baseline only reads from Apple Health.

Is it a medical device?+

No. Scores are estimates for personal insight only, not medical advice.
